title: Token usage over time
description: prompt + completion tokens per time bucket (usage fields of llm-response-body-*; streams without include_usage report no usage and count only in the request panels)

title: Requests over time
description: LLM API requests captured on the nginx proxy (llm-request-body-*; one doc per POST, parsed or raw)

title: Completed responses
description: response docs in llm-response-body-* — one per proxied request (completion object as-is, or the SSE stream reconstructed into the chat.completion shape)

title: Requests per instance
description: LLM API requests per upstream instance (upstream_addr ip:port; the port is the llama-server instance serving it)

title: Completion tokens per instance
description: completion tokens generated per upstream instance (upstream_addr ip:port = the llama-server instance)
